d:
Pakistan ke karachi men log jab kliftan ke samudr tat ki or jate hain, to raste men unhen gulabi aur pile pattharon se bani ek purani imarat dikhaee deti hai. is imarat ka nam mohatta pailes hai. is mahal ko ek hindu marvari karobari, shiv ratan chandr mohatta ne apni patni ke lie banvaya tha. mohatta pailes ko banvane ke pichhe shiv ratan mohatta ka koee karobari maqsad nahin tha. janie kya hai is khubsurat imarat ki kahani.
Riport rashid shakur
Vidiyoh navin negi aur aamra aamir
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
